header_comparison_qualification: Saved response.headers.as_bytes() serializes RFC folded values. Semantic comparison normalizes header-name case and value whitespace; original header bytes and producer JSON are unmodified. The initial reviewer literal-folding assertion was corrected without producer rerun or new network requests.
large_body_review_scope: Reviewed actual producer execution and streaming algorithm, original per-response metadata/stdout/exit and resulting digests. Large remote part bodies were not retained, and this reviewer did not independently recompute their hashes from another download. Both retained public small bodies were independently rehashed locally.
redirect_qualification: Four requests means four top-level fetch calls. urllib follows redirects and does not log complete redirect history; all four observed final URLs equal their requested HTTPS exact-commit public URLs. No categorical no-redirect or exact wire-request-count claim.
credential_scope: The helper supplied no credentials or secret lookup; normal environment proxy routing remained in use.
claim_scope: Public exact-commit archive byte readback only; this receipt makes no new engine correctness, performance or Elo acceptance claim.
